facts.text: I am planning a potluck for a family gathering today.
I am having a smaller family gathering at my grandparents' place today.
I am celebrating my grandparents' 50th wedding anniversary today.
I want recipe ideas for easy dishes that can serve a small group of people.
I think Spinach and Artichoke Dip would be a great appetizer.
I think Mini Caprese Skewers would be a great appetizer.
I am torn between Sliders and Chicken Caesar Wraps for the main course.
I want tips to make the Sliders more interesting, including toppings and different types of cheese.
I will go with Italian-Style Sliders.
My Italian-Style Sliders will include marinara sauce.
My Italian-Style Sliders will include mozzarella cheese.
My Italian-Style Sliders will include sliced pepperoni.
I want ideas for a simple anniversary cake or dessert to make for my grandparents.
I will make the Classic Vanilla Cake with a light powdered sugar glaze.
I will put a simple "50" on top of the cake.
I will use chocolate ganache to write the "50" on top of the cake.
I want to decorate the table and the rest of the area for my grandparents' 50th anniversary.
I will use a simple yet elegant table setting with a white tablecloth.
I will add gold accents to the table setting.
I will use fresh flowers for the table setting.
I will hang family photos around the room.
I will set up a special seating area for my grandparents.
For the anniversary banner, I will use a gold balloon banner with the number "50" and my grandparents' names.
I will play my grandparents' favorite music in the background.
I will prepare a special toast.

Choosing Italian-Style Sliders with marinara sauce, mozzarella cheese, and sliced pepperoni
Planning to make Classic Vanilla Cake with light powdered sugar glaze and a "50" on top
Using chocolate ganache to write the "50" on top of the cake

Planning table and room decorations for the 50th anniversary (white tablecloth, gold accents, fresh flowers, family photos, special seating area, gold balloon banner with "50" and grandparents' names, favorite music, special toast)
